name: tun degraded
compose:
services:
  vpn:
    image: wireguard:latest
    devices:
      - /dev/net/tun:/dev/net/tun
    cap_add:
      - NET_ADMIN

reasons: service vpn uses TUN/NET_ADMIN inside the rootless network namespace (prefer a userspace mode)
service app runs as id 70000, outside the rootless id range (0–65535)
